verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers AI-driven extraction through Stagehand and its agents, so choosing the extraction model is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents configuring a local or self-hosted LLM, or any model-provider choice at all. The community items about BrowserStation as an open-source alternative concern self-hosting browsers, not LLM backends, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
